ELIGIBILITY TEST: 3C requires a daily close beyond a 25-day boundary by at least 0.25 x ATR14. Downside confirmation needs a close at or below 7243.10 - 20.61 = 7222.49; upside confirmation needs a close at or above 7624.60 + 20.61 = 7645.21. The D-1 close of 7387.30 is inside the range and 164.81 pts above the downside requirement, so there is no confirmed break and the trade is not eligible. The 25-day low was in fact set intraday on D-1 itself and the session closed 144.20 pts back above it - a failed retest, which is the setup for a later 3C, not a break. Suppression is therefore mandatory and is emitted as a row with null levels. Both numbers descend from the excluded retail CFD low of 7330; on the slice the 25-day low is 7243.10, so 7322 lies roughly 79 pts inside the range and would not have been a breakout on any basis. The report also used a 5-minute confirmation timeframe that appears nowhere else in its stated daily cash-session bar basis.
